She bears a striking resemblance to [[Flint]] and [[Buck]], but the relationship between them, if any, is unknown. ==In the core series games== For most of the game, Zisu can be found at the [[training grounds]] in [[Jubilife Village]]. She offers the {{player}} various services: * [[Move Tutor#Legends: Arceus|Tutoring new moves]] to a Pokémon, in exchange for [[Pokémon Dollar|money]] ** As the player increases their rank, more moves will be available to choose from * Help a Pokémon [[move mastery|master a move]], in exchange for a [[Seed of Mastery]] * Exchanging Grit items, at the following rates ** 1 [[Grit Gravel]] for 10 [[Grit Dust]]s ** 1 [[Grit Pebble]] for 10 [[Grit Gravel]]s ** 1 [[Grit Rock]] for 10 [[Grit Pebble]]s Zisu's services become temporarily inaccessible from [[Task (Legends: Arceus)#Missions|Mission]] 13: "Disaster Looming" to Mission 17: "Atop Mount Coronet" due to the player's exile from Jubilife Village. She can sometimes be found at Dagero's photography studio in Jubilife Village, and when talked to, she will ask to take a picture with the player. ===Pokémon=== By speaking to [[Ingo]] at the training [[File:ZisuAstralRadiance189.jpg|200px|thumb|right|{{TCG|Full Art card|Full Art}} print of Zisu]] {{main|Zisu (Astral Radiance 159)}} '''Zisu''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the {{TCG|Time Gazer}} expansion before debuting in English in the {{TCG|Astral Radiance}} expansion, with a regular print, a {{TCG|Full Art card|Full Art}} and a Rainbow Rare print, all with artwork by [[KirisAki]]. This card allows the player to draw cards until they have one more than their opponent. {{-}} ==Trivia== *Zisu's hair resembles the ears of a {{p|Lopunny}}. * Zisu's final team in the Path of Tenacity uses the same Pokémon as [[Flint]]'s team in {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}} and his initial team in {{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}. * Upon defeating Zisu's fourth Path of Tenacity team, she will reveal that [[Cyllene]] was one of the best swordswomen in all of [[Hoenn]]. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{Omega Ruby color}}; border:3px solid #{{HeartGold color}}" |- ! style="background:#{{Omega Ruby color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{Omega Ruby color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{Omega Ruby color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ペリーラ ''Perilla'' | From the genus ''{{wp|Perilla}}'', matching to [[Flint]] being named after a variety of perilla in Japanese |- | English, Indonesian,
